'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Arab countries]]
****[[2026 Iranian strikes on Bahrain]]
*****[[Iran]] says that it has launched [[Ballistic missile program of Iran|ballistic missile]] and [[Unmanned aerial vehicles in the Iranian military|drone]] [[drone warfare|strike]]s at targets in [[Bahrain]], including a drone vessel depot, an [[artificial intelligence]] center used for targeting, and the Al-Sakhir Air Base, as part of the 11th phase of its [[Saegheh]] operation. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/us-israel-iran-war/iranian-army-says-it-targeted-us-military-base-in-bahrain-with-drone-strike/4000873 (AA)] [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20260717-iran-says-it-destroyed-us-unmanned-depot-ai-center-in-bahrain/ (''Middle East Monitor'')]
****[[2026 Iranian strikes on Jordan]]
*****[[Jordan]] reports having intercepted projectiles fired from [[Iran]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/us-israel-iran-war/iran-says-it-targeted-us-al-udeid-air-base-in-qatar/4001304 (AA)]
****[[Kuwait in the 2026 Iran war|2026 Iranian strikes on Kuwait]]
*****Iranian strikes damage a [[Desalination in Kuwait|desalination plant]] and a [[Energy in Kuwait|power plant]] in [[Kuwait]], according to the [[Ministry of Electricity, Water and Renewable Energy (Kuwait)|Kuwaiti energy ministry]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-strikes-kuwait-gulf-bahrain-desalination-25e6d5c8d8a027897b3fb80fad57b7d2 (AP)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/17/oil-price-today-brent-wti.html (CNBC)]
****[[2026 Iranian strikes on Oman]]
*****The [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy]] launches attacks on radar facilities in [[Oman]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/iran-s-irgc-says-it-targeted-radar-sites-in-oman/4000997 (AA)]
****[[Syria in the 2026 Iran war|2026 Iranian strikes on Syria]]
*****[[Iranian state media]] reports that Iran's [[Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps]] have targeted a [[United States Special Operations Command]] in [[Al-Tanf]] in response to the killing of Iranian soldiers in [[Iranshahr, Iran|Iranshahr]], [[Sistan and Baluchestan province]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2651240/middle-east (''Arab News'')]
****[[2026 Iranian strikes on Qatar]]
*****The [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Aerospace Force]] launches an attack at [[Al Udeid Air Base]] in [[Qatar]], and claims to have caused damage to equipment there, while [[Qatar Armed Forces|Qatar's armed forces]] claim to have intercepted Iranian attacks. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/us-israel-iran-war/iran-says-it-targeted-us-al-udeid-air-base-in-qatar/4001304 (AA)]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****The [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]]'s [[United States Central Command|Central Command]] (CENTCOM) confirms that they have destroyed the Chah Bahar Shahid Kalantari Port surveillance tower in [[Chabahar Port]] yesterday, which was allegedly used by the [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] for tracking commercial vessels transiting the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/us-military-says-it-destroyed-a-iranian-port-surveillance-tower/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on the Kurdistan Region]]
****Iranian drone strikes near [[Erbil]], [[Kurdistan Region]], [[Iraq]], kill eight Kurdish rebels and injure several more. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/iranian-strikes-kill-eight-kurdish-rebels-in-iraq-opposition-group-says/ (AFP via ''The Times of Israel'')]
***The U.S. CENTCOM launches [[July 2026 United States strikes against Iran|strikes]] against Iran for a seventh consecutive night. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jul/17/us-launches-seventh-night-of-iran-strikes-as-hormuz-conflict-escalates (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Gaza war]]
***Around eight [[Palestinians]] are reported to be killed in an [[airstrike]] on a funeral in central [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/israeli-drone-strike-on-funeral-gathering-in-central-gaza-kills-8-injures-20/4001564 (AA)]
***The [[Israel]]i [[Israel Defense Forces|military]] and [[Shin Bet]] confirm that they have killed [[Hamas]] commander Anas Mahmoud Ahmad Hamdan, who served as a "right-hand man" of [[13 July 2024 al-Mawasi attack|former]] [[Al-Qassam Brigades]] [[List of leaders of Hamas#List of military leaders in the Gaza Strip|commander]] [[Mohammed Deif]], in an [[airstrike]] in [[Khan Yunis]], Gaza Strip. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/top-hamas-aide-who-held-hostages-during-war-killed-in-strike-on-khan-younis/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[War in the Sahel]]
**An attack on a [[Niger Armed Forces|military]] deployment in [[Téra]], [[Tillabéri Region]], [[Niger]], kills 16 soldiers and injures 23 others, while [[Mass media in Niger|state media]] reports that security forces have killed 15 attackers. [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/world-news/attack-kills-16-soldiers-in-junta-ruled-niger-state-media/articleshow/132496755.cms (AFP via ''The Economic Times'')]

**The confirmed death toll from the doublet earthquakes that struck northern [[Venezuela]] in June rises to 5,069 people. [https://apnews.com/article/venezuela-earthquakes-deaths-d32eecaceabe88b93670e27accabfea2 (AP)]

**A large fire breaks out among terraced houses in [[Krokstadelva]], [[Drammen]], [[Norway]], spreading rapidly between multiple housing blocks and prompting mass evacuations. The municipality declares a crisis and calls in fire crews from eight neighboring municipalities. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/more-than-50-homes-destroyed-norway-fire-2026-07-17/ (Reuters)] [https://www.vg.no/nyheter/i/k0dn8X/brann-i-rekkehus-i-drammen-sprer-seg-videre (VG)]

*Four people are killed and nine others are injured after a head-on collision between two overspeeding cars along the [[N-25 National Highway]] in [[Wadh]], [[Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.dawn.com/news/2016375/four-killed-nine-injured-as-two-cars-collide-in-wadh (''Dawn'')]
*A [[multiple vehicle collision|nine-vehicle pile-up]] in [[Deli Serdang]], [[North Sumatra]], [[Indonesia]], kills at least four and injures eight others. [https://english.news.cn/20260717/caa2cbd87b8045ad96dcd759e8004bf7/c.html (Xinhua)]

*A nine-story building under construction near [[Conakry]], [[Guinea]], collapses due to heavy rainfall, killing three people and injuring several others. [https://english.news.cn/africa/20260718/7f14e6aebf27442c8c95f940ab83eb37/c.html (Xinhua)]
*Two citizens are killed from weather-related incidents and 53,000 homes are reported to be without power during severe thunderstorms across several regions of [[France]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/storms-leave-2-dead-53-000-households-without-power-in-france/4001000 (AA)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 Bangladesh measles outbreak]]
**The death tolls from the [[measles]] outbreak in [[Bangladesh]] reaches 780 after one child is reported to have died from the disease by the [[Directorate General of Health Services (Bangladesh)|Directorate General of Health Services]]. [https://www.dhakatribune.com/amp/bangladesh/health/415373/measles-outbreak-death-toll-reaches-780-as-one (''Dhaka Tribune'')]
*[[2026 United States cyclosporiasis outbreak]]
**[[Taylor Farms]] [[Product recall|recalls]] their [[iceberg lettuce|iceburg]] [[lettuce]], traced through a farm in [[Mexico]], amidst the ongoing [[cyclosporiasis]] outbreak in the [[United States]], which is caused by ''[[Cyclospora cayetanensis]]''. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/antoniopequenoiv/2026/07/17/taylor-farms-recalls-iceberg-lettuce-traced-to-farm-in-mexico-amid-cyclosporiasis-outbreak/ (''Forbes'')]
**[[Michigan]], U.S., surpasses 5,000 cases of cyclosporiasis. [https://www.detroitnews.com/story/news/local/michigan/2026/07/17/michigans-cyclosporiasis-case-total-surpasses-5000/90957125007/ (''The Detroit News'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Labour Party leadership election]]
**[[Andy Burnham]] is elected as the new [[Leader of the Labour Party (UK)|leader]] of the [[United Kingdom|British]] [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]]. He will formally succeed [[Keir Starmer]] as [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|prime minister]] on Monday. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c2lq12z1xdlo (BBC News)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2026/07/17/uk/andy-burnham-labour-leader-uk-intl (CNN)] [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/jul/17/andy-burnham-becomes-labour-leader-final-step-towards-uk-pm (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Dismissal of Mykhailo Fedorov]]
**Protests continue for a second day in [[Kyiv]], [[Ukraine]], near the [[Presidential Office Building (Kyiv)|Presidential Office Building]], demanding the return of [[Mykhailo Fedorov]] as [[Ministry of Defence (Ukraine)|Minister of Defence]] and the resignation of [[Oleksandr Syrskyi]] as the [[Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/zelenskiy-shakes-up-national-security-post-protesters-rally-second-day-2026-07-17/ (''Reuters'')]
*[[Japanese imperial succession debate]]
**Japan's [[National Diet]] amends the [[Imperial Household Law]] to allow unmarried male descendants of former imperial branches to rejoin [[Imperial House of Japan|the family]] and permit royal women to retain status after marrying [[commoner]]s, while preserving [[Agnatic primogeniture|male-only succession]]. [https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/world/2026/7/17/japan-imperial-rules-tweaked-but-still-no-woman-emperor-1151 (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]
